turns.content: We stop by a cluster of steaming pools in a rocky hollow. I peel off my boots. "Hot springs. I haven't been warm in a week."

Brennic: *eyes the steam suspiciously* "Hot water from the ground. Unnatural." *pulls his boots off anyway*
Mira: "Halvard's Atlas lists these springs as safe for bathing, though he notes the smell, which I see he did not exaggerate."
Tobbe: *sniffing* "Smells like eggs. Old eggs."
I wade in and let out a long breath. "Worth it. Come on, all of you."

Tobbe: *lowers himself in, water sloshing over the edge* "Oh. Oh, that is nice. Tobbe's arms feel better." *rubs the old burn scars gently*
Brennic: *sinks to his chin with a groan* "Leg doesn't hurt. First time in years. Don't tell anyone."
Mira: *dips her ink-stained fingers in, watching the colour lift* "It is cleaning the ink from my fingers, which soap has never once managed."
I lean back against the rock. "Maybe we stay an extra hour."

Brennic: "Extra hour. Extra day. Kesh Varran isn't going anywhere."
Tobbe: *humming tunelessly, eyes half-closed* "Tobbe agrees. Tobbe will make soup after."
Mira: "I will measure the water temperature, and then I will do absolutely nothing, which I think I have earned."
